email.body1:
Sue, saw IMPLAN launch the Forward Linkages Suite and the new AI Summary feature.

New product surface like that usually opens more enterprise accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for IMPLAN off your product and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Sue, quick follow-up for IMPLAN.

With new capabilities to sell into enterprise accounts, the pipeline target moves faster than headcount can. Most regional managers don't actually know how many meetings the team needs to book to hit the number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings IMPLAN needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Sue, last bit of proof for IMPLAN.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how IMPLAN's reply rate likely compares to other analytics-software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?

If scaling enterprise pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Taking a new product suite to market is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise motion? I'll tailor it to IMPLAN either way.
